description: Koshi River at Chatara, Nepal -- one of Nepal's largest rivers, historically prone to devastating floods; the 2008 Koshi flood displaced over 60,000 people
Narayani River at Narayanghat, Nepal -- major river draining central Nepal; feeds into the Ganges system; monsoon flooding regularly affects Chitwan district
Bagmati River at Kathmandu, Nepal -- flows through the capital; urban flooding during monsoon season impacts millions
Rapti River at Nepalgunj, Nepal -- Terai lowlands river; severe flooding in 2024 killed hundreds and displaced thousands
Melamchi River in Sindhupalchok District, Nepal -- GLOF and landslide-dam flood risk zone; 2021 Melamchi flood killed dozens and destroyed the newly built water supply tunnel
Sun Koshi River at Dolalghat, Nepal -- landslide-dammed in 2014 Jure landslide, creating a massive flood risk; earthquake-triggered GLOF corridor
Karnali River at Chisapani, Nepal -- Nepal's longest river; extreme flood risk during monsoon; 2024 floods devastated downstream communities
West Rapti River near Kusum, Nepal -- severely affected in September 2024 floods that killed over 200 people across Nepal
